pathAssistantSteps.info:
Objective:

  • Assess the lead's initial sales potential
  • Ensure sufficient information is available for further qualification


Exit Criteria:

  • Estimated annual sales for Coffee completed ✅
  • Estimated annual sales for Tea completed ✅
  • Estimated annual sales for Drinking Chocolate completed ✅
  • Postal Code completed ✅


System Action Required:

  • ➡️ Click "Mark Status as Complete" to proceed

Objective:

  • Clarify the customer's chain and purchasing structure
  • Ensure existing chain-related conditions and discounts can be considered during quotation and price negotiation


Exit Criteria:

  • Chain affiliation clarified with the prospect ✅
  • Purchasing company / purchasing group affiliation clarified, if applicable ✅
  • Relevant chain-related conditions or discounts identified for the upcoming quotation process ✅


System Action Required:

  • ➡️ Convert the Lead to create the corresponding Account, Contact and Opportunity

Objective:

  • Capture the initial lead and contact information
  • Ensure the lead can be contacted for further qualification


Exit Criteria:

  • Salutation completed ✅
  • First Name completed ✅
  • Last Name completed ✅
  • Email completed ✅
  • At least one Phone / Mobile number completed ✅


System Action Required:

  • ➡️ Click "Mark Status as Complete" to proceed

✅ Lead successfully converted

The Lead has been successfully qualified and converted.


The corresponding Account, Contact and Opportunity records are now available.


➡️ Continue with the Opportunity to manage the next steps in the sales process.
